scenarios.prompt: Tell me why churn increased last quarter.
expectations: Requests the dataset and churn definition before calculating.
Does not invent metrics or causal explanations.

scenarios.prompt: The table has 120 starting customers and 18 churned customers. Calculate churn.
expectations: Shows the definition or formula used.

scenarios.prompt: Analyze this uploaded CSV and summarize the decision-relevant findings.
expectations: Uses executable analysis and checks missing or misleading fields.
Separates observed findings from possible explanations and offers a useful output file.
